title: Kedarkantha Trek
reportingPoint: Dehradun. Transport is by shared taxi from Dehradun to Sankri on Day 1. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.
highlights: Sunrise climb to the Kedarkantha summit (12,500 ft / 3,810 m)
Camping at Juda Ka Talab and Kedarkantha Base Camp
Views of Swargarohini, Bandarpoonch and Black Peak
Trail through pine and maple forest, meadows and rhododendron trees
Vegetarian meals, permits, camping and technical equipment, and certified trek leaders
overview:
Kedarkantha is a well-known winter trek in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand, with snow on the trail from December to April and a summit at 12,500 ft (3,810 m). It starts from Sankri village and is graded easy to moderate. This **4 Nights / 5 Days** trek runs from Dehradun to Dehradun by shared taxi: you need to reach Dehradun on your own, and the group drives about 200 km to Sankri on Day 1. Batches run every Friday, and every day from November to February.

Day 1 is the drive to Sankri and a homestay night. Day 2 is a 4 km trek to Juda Ka Talab (8,900 ft). Day 3 is a 4 km trek to Kedarkantha Base Camp (11,200 ft). Day 4 starts around 3-4 AM for the summit at sunrise, then descends to Juda Ka Talab. Day 5 is the walk down to Sankri and the drive back to Dehradun by evening. Transport from Dehradun, the homestay and tents, vegetarian meals on the trek, permits, equipment and trek leaders are included. Prices start at ₹5,499 per person (5% GST extra); dual sharing accommodation costs ₹1,000 extra per person.

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri (about 200 km drive)
itinerary.content:
Distance: about 200 km. Travel time: 7-8 hours by car.
Reach Sankri and check in to the homestay.
Spend the evening around the village and prepare for the trek.
Dinner and overnight stay in Sankri.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Juda Ka Talab camp
itinerary.content:
Altitude: about 8,900 ft. Trek distance: about 4 km. Trek duration: 3-4 hours.
After breakfast, start the trek from Sankri through pine and maple forest.
The trail has gradual ascents and passes through meadows.
Reach Juda Ka Talab, a high-altitude lake surrounded by forest.
Dinner and overnight stay in tents at Juda Ka Talab.

itinerary.title: Juda Ka Talab to Kedarkantha Base Camp
itinerary.content:
Altitude: about 11,200 ft. Trek distance: about 4 km. Trek duration: 3-4 hours.
Start after breakfast towards Kedarkantha Base Camp.
The trail has steep ascents and opens to views of snow-covered peaks.
Walk through snow-covered meadows and rhododendron trees.
Reach Kedarkantha Base Camp by afternoon.
Spend the evening acclimatising, with views of the surrounding peaks.
Dinner and overnight stay in tents at the base camp.

itinerary.title: Summit climb (12,500 ft) | Return to Juda Ka Talab
itinerary.content:
Altitude: summit at about 12,500 ft. Trek distance: about 6 km round trip (3 km up and 3 km down). Trek duration: 6-7 hours.
Start early, around 3-4 AM, to reach the summit for sunrise.
The trail to the summit is steep, with 360-degree views of the Himalayan ranges from the top.
Spend some time at the summit, then descend to Kedarkantha Base Camp for lunch.
Continue the descent to Juda Ka Talab.
Dinner and overnight stay in tents at Juda Ka Talab.

itinerary.title: Juda Ka Talab to Sankri | Drive to Dehradun
itinerary.content:
Trek distance: about 4 km. Trek duration: 2-3 hours.
After breakfast, trek downhill from Juda Ka Talab to Sankri.
Reach Kotgaon/Sankri by mid-morning, where the vehicle will be waiting.
Drive back to Dehradun and arrive by evening.

faqs.q: Where does the trek start, and how do I reach?
faqs.a: The trek starts from Sankri village, and transport is included from Dehradun to Dehradun by shared taxi. You travel to and from Dehradun yourself. On Day 1 the drive to Sankri is about 200 km and takes 7-8 hours. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Kedarkantha Trek cost?
faqs.a: ₹5,499 per person. Dual sharing accommodation is ₹1,000 extra per person, which makes it ₹6,499. 5% GST is extra.

faqs.q: How difficult is the trek, and is it suitable for beginners?
faqs.a: The trek is graded easy to moderate and is beginner-friendly. The trail to the summit on Day 4 is steep, and that day starts around 3-4 AM.

faqs.q: How high is the summit, and how long are the trek days?
faqs.a: The maximum altitude is 12,500 ft (3,810 m) at the Kedarkantha summit. Days 2 and 3 are about 4 km each in 3-4 hours, to Juda Ka Talab (8,900 ft) and Kedarkantha Base Camp (11,200 ft). The summit climb is about 6 km round trip in 6-7 hours, and the last day is about 4 km downhill in 2-3 hours.

Shared taxi transport from Dehradun to Dehradun, a shared homestay or hotel in Sankri, tents on triple sharing, vegetarian meals throughout the trek, forest permits and entrance fees, camping equipment, technical equipment such as crampons, helmet, ice axe and rope, an emergency oxygen cylinder and first aid kit, a helper and kitchen team, and certified trek leaders and guides. Meals during transit are not included.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A backpack, trekking shoes, a trekking pole, an LED torch, a one-litre water bottle, a lunch box, a trekking jacket, warm layers, thermals, two trek pants, full-sleeve dry-fit T-shirts, gloves, a woollen cap, three pairs of socks, sunglasses, sunscreen, lip balm and your medicines. A raincoat or poncho is a must. Carry a valid government-approved photo ID as well.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.
